patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.chiefComplaint: I had cancer, now I've got a cold
presentation.quote: I finished treatment eight months ago and I've been signed off since. But the moment I get so much as a sniffle my husband panics and drives me here. It really is just a cold.
presentation.triageNote: 47-year-old female with breast cancer in remission who finished treatment eight months ago and is not on chemotherapy, with three days of coryza and a mild cough; afebrile with a clear chest.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because remote cancer treatment does not make this afebrile uncomplicated cold a resource-requiring emergency.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient in remission and off treatment has mild upper-respiratory symptoms with a clear chest.
clinical.acuityReason: Remote cancer treatment does not make this afebrile uncomplicated cold a resource-requiring emergency.
keyFindings: Cancer treatment completed eight months ago
Three days of coryza and mild cough
teachingPoints: Compare with case 150. The word 'cancer' is not what makes a fever an emergency — ACTIVE chemotherapy and a neutrophil count are. Off treatment, afebrile and eight months out, she is a person with a cold.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Supportive care and return precautions would allow discharge without testing.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: an asian 47-year-old woman with short regrown hair, in a jumper and scarf, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting relaxed and upright, a tissue in one hand, handbag beside her
aiImageGeneration.expression: cheerful, healthy and slightly exasperated at being brought in
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: completely well apart from a head cold
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: an asian 47-year-old woman with short regrown hair, in a jumper and scarf, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting relaxed and upright, a tissue in one hand, handbag beside her. Expression: cheerful, healthy and slightly exasperated at being brought in. Clearly visible: short regrown hair; a slightly pink nose; an entirely relaxed, well posture. Overall: completely well apart from a head cold. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
